basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and military history enthusiast hailing from the Midwest, USA. By day, I work as an audio engineer in the broadcasting industry, and by night, I'm a tank commander in the virtual world of World of Tanks. Passionate about cars, especially my Lexus RC, and often found tinkering in the garage. I spend my free time exploring intensive care advancements and learning about crisis management. Usually online during late evenings, I'm happily married with two cats.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in audio engineering and over a decade of experience in the broadcasting field, I have honed skills in sound design and live production. My passion for gaming led me to become highly knowledgeable in World of Tanks, where I've been an active player for several years. Additionally, my interest in automotive technology is deeply rooted in personal experience and self-taught mechanical skills.
